resident.description: Generate a resident credential. Defaults to off.

origin.description: Set the FIDO2 relying party ID. Defaults to pam://hostname if empty.

appid.description: Set the FIDO2 relying party name. Defaults to origin if empty.

cose_type.description: COSE type to use during registration (ES256, EDDSA, or RS256). Defaults to ES256.

no_user_presence.description: Allow using the credential without ensuring the user’s presence. Defaults to off.

require_pin.description: Require PIN verification during authentication. Defaults to off.

require_user_verification.description: Require user verification during authentication. Defaults to off.

username.description: The name of the user registering the device. Defaults to current user if empty.

nouser.description: Print only registration information. Useful for appending to config files. Defaults to off.

debug.description: Print debug information. Defaults to off.
